$description: Package passport (ADR 0015). Where the illustration comes from in Figma, which animated layers the storyboard needs, and the exact files the preparation tool must use.

figma.name: Virtual Payments
figma.note: layers renamed to m-* roles 2026-10-12 (names only, geometry unchanged, ADR 0033); the vertical streak Rectangle 2173 stays as drawn

export.how: Figma export SVG with 'Include id attribute', sent by the team; then (1) the <mask> moved into <defs> (technical edit: the preparation tool removes ids outside <defs>, and the mask is referenced by id; rendering unchanged); (2) colours replaced by the nearest existing tokens (option B, as in Ticketing and Schedule Changes, 2026-10-12): #034152 -> #013746, #9BF4DE and #C6FFF1 -> #8CF9E5, #DFDFDF -> #CBD2D1, #154D5D -> #044F64. Then the bodies of the two cards and of the Activity card made #044F64 instead of #013746 (token illustration.avatar.circle-start) so they stand out from the page background #022E3A (compared on the stand: the Figma colour #034152, #013746 and #044F64; same fill as the accepted Schedule Changes card). Figma itself was not changed. Embedded noise PNG re-encoded losslessly as an indexed PNG. Original: source/figma-export.raw.svg.
